title: Over-abstraction: structure wrapped around a one-liner

body.signal: A class, helper, or indirection layer wrapping a single arithmetic expression or builtin call that has exactly one caller (e.g. celsius_to_fahrenheit wrapped in pointless structure).
body.failure_mode: Every layer adds naming and indirection cost with zero behavior benefit; the reader must visit three definitions to learn one formula.
body.detection: AST analysis: helper with exactly one call site and a trivially small body (single expression or single return) is an inlining candidate.
body.fix_strategy: Inline the indirection. Gate: tests plus equivalence; the public API must remain unchanged.
